title:
Comment of Linda Obedzinski in Docket(s)/Project(s) P-15423-000
Submission Date: 10/29/2026

documents.name: 151965.txt
documents.text:
Linda Obedzinski, Glastonbury, CT.
As someone who deeply cares about beluga whales, I am quite alarmed at the proposal for studying data center construction in waters used by an endangered population of these whales. Fewer than 400 Cook Inlet belugas remain, and these whales use vocalisations and their heating, along with echolocation, to navigate through murky waters. Construction would significantly increase the noise in their environment, negatively impacting their ability to navigate, communicate, and even find food. 

This proposal is a terrible idea in this ecologically sensitive location. I urge you to deny permission the study.
